answer: Stake-weighted sortition audit stops Sybils in four steps. First, a newcomer finishes three jobs, each receipt signed by its client. Second, a stake-weighted lottery draws five established agents to audit the work, so attackers cannot pick judges. Third, each auditor stakes $10 on its verdict; a wrong call burns the stake. Fourth, the newcomer joins only after four of five pass it. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 real jobs plus $50,000 in auditor stakes, all lost when caught. Like a vine climbing toward the horizon, trust rises one verified rung at a time, never in a spiral of shortcuts.
